thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - Observed sustained latency and 5xx increase for hosted inference (us-west) starting ~11:12 UTC. Automatically opened bridge and paged the oncall rotation. Root TS 1772567890. Paging @Anya and SRE team.

Anya: I'm on the bridge. Taking ownership — building timeline and triage now. Can someone drop top-level impact (customers / routes) here?

Devon: seeing 3x p50 and p95 token latency spikes, and error rate up ~12%. Looks concentrated on `text-generation` route hitting model-variant `gptx-8q`. Linking perf dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dashboard/incident/1772567890

Mike: FWIW a few pods started restarting around 11:11. I grabbed the kube events and runtime logs. Pasting the last 30 lines from one runtime:```
[2026-03-15T11:11:04Z] ERROR runtime: kv_cache fetch failed: invalid-kv-handle
[2026-03-15T11:11:04Z] WARN  runtime: falling back to uncached path
[2026-03-15T11:11:05Z] ERROR runtime: OOM while preparing attention cache, evicting entries
[2026-03-15T11:11:06Z] INFO  servicer: request rejected: capacity-exceeded
```

Anya: thanks. Hypothesis 1: KV cache metadata corruption leading to repeated fallbacks and OOMs -> increased latency. Hypothesis 2: degraded network to cache tier causing high miss rate. Hypothesis 3: recent config change? Anyone deployed near 11:10 UTC?

DeployBot: Deploy event detected at 11:08 UTC by `mike`: rollout `gptx-8q@v12` -> healthcheck failures triggered 11:10 -> partial rollback initiated.

Mike: I rolled back the model variant at 11:13 to v11 as a quick mitigation, but latency hasn't returned to baseline. Rollback logs:```
> rollback gptx-8q from v12 to v11 -- ok
> draining pods... 3/5 drained
> new pods ready 11:14
```

Devon: can you paste the runtime config diff from the deploy? Looking for any KV/cache flags or client library bump.

Mike: the deploy was just model binary and a minor runtime bump `runtime v2.4.3 -> v2.4.4` (no config flags). Patch diff snippet:```
- runtime: v2.4.3
+ runtime: v2.4.4
- model: gptx-8q@v11
+ model: gptx-8q@v12
```

Anya: OK. Action items now: 1) collect full logs from affected pods (Devon) 2) disable KV cache for gptx-8q to validate hypothesis (Mike) 3) draft status page blurb (Sarah) 4) compile impacted customer list (Anya).

Devon: grabbing logs now. Quick grep shows repeated errors like `invalid-kv-handle` across 12 pods. Also an internal trace shows cache checksum mismatch:```
trace_id=0x7f2c... func=kvValidate status=checksum_mismatch
```

Mike: I can hotfix to disable KV cache at runtime for that model - doing a config patch (will be safe, will increase token cost but should reduce churn). Applying now.

DeployBot: Config patch applied to group `gptx-8q` at 11:22 UTC: `kv_cache.enabled=false` -- rollout success.

Anya: monitoring. Can folks post before/after p95 numbers? Also Sarah, any quick status page copy you want to share for approval?

Devon: p95 token latency pre-mitigation ~ 1.8s -> now trending down to ~0.9s over the last 3m. Error rate dropping but still elevated (4%).

Sarah: Drafting short status page — propose: "We are investigating increased latency and errors for hosted inference in US-West impacting a subset of requests. A mitigation is in progress; customers may see intermittent slowdowns or 5xx errors. We'll provide updates every 30 minutes." Thoughts?

Anya: fine but be explicit about ETA for next update (30m). Also include contact for high-impact customers: se-oncall@redwood.com.

Sarah: updated: "... Next update: in 30 minutes. If you're experiencing production impact, contact se-oncall@redwood.com." Ready to publish on status.redwood.com?

Anya: +1 publish. I'll notify a few customers personally after we confirm the p95 is stable for 10m.

Devon: digging into why checksum_mismatch happened. Preliminary note: a race in the cache compaction path could corrupt metadata on some hosts after runtime bump; correlating host kernel versions and storage driver. Pulling kernel and FS info from affected nodes.

Mike: internal note — since rollback to v11 didn't fully help, and disabling kv_cache brought p95 down, this points at cache layer interaction with runtime v2.4.4. We'll open a follow-up PR to revert runtime bump and add additional integration tests for cache checksum validation.

Anya: customer impact list: I pulled recent customer requests hitting the route — A: AcmeCorp (500 requests affected, retries logged), B: MobiApps (errors causing degraded search), C: BetaLabs (some requests delayed). Reached out to account SEs for A and B.

Elliot: I'm taking the next shift in 20m. Quick handoff notes: 1) KV cache disabled for `gptx-8q` (mitigation) 2) p95 ~0.9s, error rate 4% and trending down 3) rollout and deploy events linked in dashboard 4) Rachel (SE for AcmeCorp) notified. I'll monitor for 1h and escalate if error >5% or p95 >1.5s.

Anya: thanks Elliot — assigning follow-ups in the incident board: `INC-1772567890` tasks: reproduce checksum_mismatch, root cause writeup, runtime revert PR, customer comms follow-through.

Sarah: I've posted the status page update and emailed the stakeholder list with the short blurb + mitigation note. Copy: "We implemented a temporary mitigation that disables KV caching for the affected model; this reduces latency while we finish our RCA. We do not expect data loss."

Devon: still collecting full traces; attaching one trace id for the RCA thread: `trace=0x7f2c8a9b` (will paste logs into the incident ticket).

Mike: internal TODOs — roll back runtime bump in canary, add checksum assert, improve startup validation to catch corrupt metadata.

Anya: closing the live bridge for now (no active paging). Keeping the incident open for RCA and comms. If anyone sees regression ping @Elliot (oncall). Thanks all. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: Incident state changed to "Mitigated" at 11:48 UTC. Post-incident RCA scheduled for 14:00 UTC in #eng-runtime.
